caveats:
The gazetteer defines administrative level 3 features, but level 3 polygons are unavailable.

Administrative level 2 features are unavailable for Tbilisi, the Autonomous Republic of Abkhazia, and for the area known as the Provisional Administration.
dataset_source: National Statistics Office of Georgia [Administraciuli erTeulebi]
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other:
Dataset: Accessed from "administraciuli erTeulebi", National Statistics Office of Georgia; modifications by OCHA.

The (transliterated) names in Georgian language was reviewed and corrected by the Ministry of Emergency Situations.

The administrative level 0-2 gazetteer was prepared by ITOS.  An  administrative level 3 supplementary gazetteer is also provided.
name: cod-ab-geo
notes:
Georgia administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 13 Region, city, or autonomous republic  
- Admin 2: 70 District or self-governing city, partial coverage  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 31 January 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 18 October 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 28 August 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 28 August 2019: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-romena).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
